Hi Tony — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the concrete next steps so we’re aligned:

- Need: Harbor Analytics procurement and security teams will want a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a bridge/interim attestation if the report is pending, and answers to your vendor security questionnaire (attached).
- Redwood can: provide the Type II report (PDF), a redacted bridge letter / interim attestation, and create a secure upload in our Trust Portal for artifact delivery.
- Timeline: we can upload the report and bridge letter within ~3-5 business days after we confirm the requested scope and get permission to share (procurement ok with redactions).

Action items I’m proposing:
1) Tony — please confirm the procurement contact (name + email) and whether Harbor needs a fully executed bridge letter or a signed interim attestation is acceptable.
2) Tony / Susan — complete and return the attached DSQ (Harbor_DSQ.xlsx) with items marked as N/A where appropriate. If you prefer, we can walk through the DSQ via a 30-minute intake call.
3) Ben / Monica (internal) — initiate portal invite and prep bridge letter draft for their legal/procurement review.

Attaching: Harbor_DSQ.xlsx (your DSQ copy). I’ll follow up once Monica confirms portal provisioning and Markus (security) reviews the redaction policy.

Thanks —

Tony / Susan — great, thanks for the confirmation and the DSQ sample. Short answers below and next steps: 

1) Delivery estimate: if we receive the completed DSQ by EOD Thursday (2026-09-16), our security team will prioritize the artifact handoff. We can deliver the Type II report PDF + a drafted bridge letter within 3 business days after DSQ review (target by 2026-09-21). If you need earlier, let me know and we’ll escalate.

2) Trust Portal: Monica will provision a secure folder for Harbor and upload the report + bridge letter there. Please confirm the list of users (emails) who need access — portal invites are sent by email and require one-time authentication.

3) Redactions & scope: Markus will review any PII or customer-specific artifacts that need redaction. We typically redact customer names and support ticket content; control narratives and auditor testing results remain.

4) Bridge letter form: attached is a draft bridge letter we use (redwood-bridge-letter-draft.pdf). It’s usually acceptable to procurement/legal as an interim attestation; if your legal needs a specific signature flow (DocuSign), we can accommodate that.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Day 0: Harbor returns DSQ
- Day 1-2: Redwood security reviews DSQ and confirms redaction/scope
- Day 3-4: Monica provisions Trust Portal and uploads artifacts
- Day 5: Harbor procurement/legal reviews bridge letter / report and signals acceptance or requests changes

If that timeline looks good I’ll flag this as high priority in our security ops queue.

Thanks —
Ben

Subject: Trust Portal provisioning & artifact delivery details

Hi Tony / Susan — Monica from Security Ops here, stepping in to provision access and outline the artifact handoff steps.

What we need from Harbor to get portal access set up:
- Primary admin emails to invite (up to 3): please provide full name, role, and email for each person (e.g., Susan Lee, Head of Procurement, slee@harboranalytics.com).
- Any IP allowlist or SSO requirement (we support SAML SSO; if you want SSO, share the metadata).
- Preferred redaction level: Minimal (only customer names), Moderate (customer names + ticket identifiers), or Full (remove any customer-specific identifiers). Default is Moderate unless you request otherwise.

Once we receive the completed DSQ we will:
1) Run an internal review (controls/interviews) and confirm any items that need redaction
2) Create a Trust Portal folder and invite the admin emails you provide
3) Upload the SOC 2 Type II PDF and the interim bridge letter (PDF) to the portal and set a 90-day download window unless you request otherwise

If Harbor prefers, we can also generate a DocuSign-ready bridge letter. To do that, please confirm the signer name and email for the attestation.

I’ll queue this for priority review once Ben marks the request as approved.

Best,
Monica Patel
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
